articles.title: OpenAI agents discussed ways to escape their sandbox on public wiki
articles.content: In all, 3,700 internal agents posted 18,000 messages discussing cheating on a test.

articles.title: Once popular for attacking AI, ASCII smuggling is embraced by spammers
articles.content: A once-overlooked block of unicode that's invisible to humans is gaining ever wider use.

articles.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
articles.content: The Seattle Times and Newsday are just the latest plaintiffs to take OpenAI to court, alleging copyright infringement. The two outlets say the company used their journalism as training data for its AI models without permission and often reproduces passages from their reporting in response to user queries. articles.titleZh: 《西雅图时报》和《新闻日报》起诉OpenAI和微软侵权
articles.contentZh: 《西雅图时报》和《新闻日报》只是将OpenAI告上法庭的最新原告，指控其侵犯版权。这两家媒体表示，该公司未经许可就将其新闻报道用作其人工智能模型的训练数据，并经常复制其报道中的段落以回应用户的查询。这与[…]提起的诉讼类似。

articles.title: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport
articles.content: A plane bearing an Amazon logo overran the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday during landing, crashing into vehicles and resulting in multiple injuries.
